Week of July 12

Filed under: #weekly | Sun Jul 19 2026

I said I wouldn't forget. I said I wouldn't forget but I forgot anyway and it's Monday. Ah, well, luckily I just do this for fun and this isn't that important. Not my fault. I have unmedicated ADHD that's supposed to be medicated but the medication that I was prescribed (Focalin XR) does not work on me.

I finally got my website to work. Isn't that exciting!? Now I have a place to put my UTAU. I'm genuinely so fucking close to finishing my UTAU I think. Well, the Japanese VCV. Then I wanted to record an English CVVC and a Japanese CVVC. I think I will do the Japanese CVVC first and then the English CVVC, since I've never done a CVVC before and want to practice before I fuck up the English CVVC and have to rerecord and reoto everything 50 times. (This is what happened with the Japanese VCV).

And then when I'm done with that I can finally release them to the world.

Maybe I can even finish their VCV by the end of this week..? That would be insane if I did. I'm going to put that as my goal for this week.

BTW: I did not find my Apple Pencil and I had to buy a new one...how upsetting. I've been drawing Art Fight attacks again but I'm so locked into UTAU development...

OK. See you next week. Bye
